from collections import Counter

def transform(grid):
    R, C = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    cnt = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row)
    bg = cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(R) for c in range(C) if grid[r][c] != bg]
    cellset = set(cells)
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    used = set()

    def extend(r, c, dr, dc, color):
        rr, cc = r + dr, c + dc
        while 0 <= rr < R and 0 <= cc < C and grid[rr][cc] == bg:
            out[rr][cc] = color
            rr += dr; cc += dc

    # same-color diagonal pairs = lines
    for r, c in cells:
        if (r, c) in used:
            continue
        for dr, dc in ((1, 1), (1, -1)):
            r2, c2 = r + dr, c + dc
            if 0 <= r2 < R and 0 <= c2 < C and grid[r2][c2] == grid[r][c] and (r2, c2) in cellset:
                col = grid[r][c]
                extend(r, c, -dr, -dc, col)
                extend(r2, c2, dr, dc, col)
                used.add((r, c)); used.add((r2, c2))
                break

    # remaining cells: diagonal pairs with differing colors (one is a marker)
    rem = [p for p in cells if p not in used]
    for i in range(len(rem)):
        for j in range(i + 1, len(rem)):
            (r1, c1), (r2, c2) = rem[i], rem[j]
            if abs(r1 - r2) != 1 or abs(c1 - c2) != 1:
                continue
            cA, cB = grid[r1][c1], grid[r2][c2]
            col = cA if cnt[cA] >= cnt[cB] else cB
            src = (r1, c1) if grid[r1][c1] == col else (r2, c2)
            oth = (r2, c2) if src == (r1, c1) else (r1, c1)
            dr = 1 if oth[0] > src[0] else -1
            dc = 1 if oth[0] == src[0] and oth[1] > src[1] else (oth[1] - src[1])
            dc = 1 if dc > 0 else -1
            extend(src[0], src[1], dr, dc, col)
    return out
